scope: Reconstruction of the margin report from the deposited radius-eight certificate by exact rational arithmetic; proves the explicit constant of (ND.10) from deposited materials.
policy: deleted monomial bounded by an available variable bound (other factor <= 1) or product bound; largest p, then smallest k, then smallest L; residual row: min base exponent, max b-slope, power-of-two majorant of 1 + sum |a| 2^L; P divides by |a| via floor(log2|a|); S square root with coefficient rounded upward; D subtracts b; F exports b = p/(2(k+1)) with B >= 2(L+1)/p; final B >= (L_i+1)/p_i for every variable.
conclusion: Gamma_T(g) >= (pi^2/41472) * 2^(-2B) ||g||_2^4 on P_8 with the B above; since B <= 2^714 this confirms the printed (ND.10) constant (pi^2/41472) * 2^(-2^715). Two independent implementations of the compiler produced the identical B.
